items.title: Synaptics CFO Resigns, Company Skips Successor Search Before Merger
items.summary: Synaptics Inc (NASDAQ:SYNA) shares are up during Friday’s premarket session, trading higher by almost 2% as the company announced a transition in its executive leadership.
